Mystery adventure: research and reconstruction

The relic hunt, George’s terminal interface, pressure-gallery route, Billings’ dialogue and escape fight are an original game adaptation. They are not a claim to reproduce one canonical sequence.

The gas service line is a story element. The gallery, exact position, capping tools and four-step repair are reconstructed for this game. The hidden schematic says so.

The requested exterior numbers run from 0 through 50. Silo 0 is a game extension. A surveyed map locating every numbered silo was not established by the reviewed sources: the clustered field follows the supplied image composition, with 17 next to 18, but uncertain number assignments and distances remain reconstructed. Silo 17’s three accessible landings are reconstructed above a flooded lower space.

The Georgia book depicts an earlier outside world. It does not prove today’s outside air is safe. Billings helps after seeing the page and evidence that the service line is capped.

Sources: Apple TV series overview; Apple production images; secondary finale recap. Existing production references remain in the game’s Research & accuracy panel.
